citations.assessment: The checked account names the same pair, reverses the introductory order in an alternate wording, and leaves the successful ordination unidentified.
The corresponding entry gives the same two names and distinguishes the unnamed outcomes.
The matching internal entry cites the separately attested Yishmael in Avodah Zarah and reciprocates the pointer.

holds.reason: Heilprin immediately questions the opening assignment. The direct Bavli says one of the pair was ordained and leaves the names unassigned.
The checked Avodah Zarah directly names Yishmael, and Sanhedrin has Shimon. They occur in separate narrative contexts. The possible textual conflation remains a proposal.
